name: Shape an idea
label: IMAGE & OBJECT
description: Collect a direction, build the object, and prepare images to share.
handoff: Keep your original model and image project. Export an image when the next tool needs a picture rather than geometry.

name: Tell it in motion
label: FILM & ANIMATION
description: Plan a sequence, create the motion, and finish a small film.
handoff: Keep editable animation files and source media beside the film project. Import an exported video into the next editor; keep captions separately.

name: Find your sound
label: MUSIC & AUDIO
description: Explore a rhythm, develop a session, and keep a finished mix.
handoff: Keep the session and source recordings. Check an exported audio file before using it in film or sharing it.

name: Give it a home
label: WEB & PORTFOLIO
description: Arrange your work, build a page, and check its public destination.
handoff: Keep exported page files and screenshots. WebLab is a preview with no project reopening; the separate Website Checkup inspects an existing URL.

name: Keep the good things
label: READ & ORGANIZE
description: Gather references and keep useful files close to the project.
handoff: Save references and their credits. My Projects and Locker are separate stores; add the files you want to keep in each.

name: Make room for others
label: COMMUNITY
description: Share a result, join a session, or start a conversation.
handoff: Choose what to share yourself. Circle and NOW Messenger use separate identities; opening them does not upload project files.
